freeCheck.title: Try a free check first
freeCheck.what: One task of {{suite}} with a practice model. $0, no score, needs a worker online. Full evaluations call real models and cost money.
freeCheck.builtin: {{agent}} is built in and already checked.
freeCheck.ownsModel: {{agent}} calls its own model, so the free check cannot run.
freeCheck.noAgent: Pick one of your own agents in step 1 to try the free check.
freeCheck.noBenchmark: Pick a benchmark in step 3. The check uses its first task.

suitesCli.intro: Fetches the source and adds it as a benchmark.
